Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Actually, cards on out-of-play cards are out-of-play themselves, by
default. So Banishment has been living on stealth errata (the obvious
one) for quite some time now, like Thanks for the Donation before
it got reworded.

But, in short, any card that has been put into play and has not been
removed from play is "in play". This is, effectively, all face-up
cards on the table (not in the ash heap or in the hand, etc.).



> Vamp A is later banished, while banished, Vamp B untaps as normal, when A
> returns, he remembers all of his past relationships and Vamp B is affected
> by the sense dep again. JIC if a second copy of Vamp A enters play for

No. Sense Dep has no effect once A leaves play. There is no provision to
restart the "no untap" effect, nor to start a new "no untap" effect.
The "no untap" effect exists from the time the action resolves until
that vampire (A) leaves play. That is, it lasts as long as A remains
in play and no longer.

> whatever reason and the original is still uncontrolled, Vamp B is still able
> to untap.

Once A has left play (via contesting, Banishment, or whatever), the effect
of Sense Dep is concluded.


